lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular distribution of high-luminance circular clusters organized in vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, specifically forming three distinct horizontal rows in the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity vertical bands intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating distinct anchor nodes in a grid pattern across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel linear features running horizontally along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.
